consigna: One sustained spoken production of at least twelve minutes: argue a contested position and then summarise the debate twice, once for an expert and once for a newcomer — with one section held in irony and one where you drop it. With a person or recorded alone. Notes are preparation only.
requisitos: Disagreement located precisely at the premise, the logic or the conclusion (week 16)
An opinion framed by how firmly you hold it, with what would change it (week 19)
One mixed conditional running from a past choice to a present result (week 14)
Four professional collocations, no broken pairings (week 20)
One narrative passage that misdirects the listener and then resolves (week 21)
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Reread the corrections from weeks 14 to 21 and note the most frequent.
*Wed (5 min).* Write three sentences carrying a located disagreement, a mixed conditional and a collocation together.
*Fri (10 min).* Record the twelve minutes. Afterwards find the point where you slipped into one register only.
autochequeo: Was the disagreement located, or just general pushback?
Did the confidence framing match how sure I actually am?
Was the dropped irony recognisable as sincerity?
promptCorreccion: This is a review of six skills at once: located disagreement, confidence-framed opinion, mixed conditionals, controlled understatement, professional collocations and narrative misdirection. (1) For each, say whether it is present and whether it is done well. (2) Say which collapsed. (3) Give me one sentence carrying three of them. Correct nothing outside these six areas. ---
